articles.headline: Scaloni: Argentina 'smelt blood' to sink England in World Cup semifinal
articles.description: Lionel Scaloni said Argentina "smelt blood" when England retreated to defend their lead to seize the opportunity to mount a dramatic comeback and secure a place in the World Cup final.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi says win over England meant most to our fans
articles.description: Lionel Messi set up two goals in the dying minutes of Argentina's semifinal against England at Mercedes-Benz Stadium on Wednesday to snatch a 2-1 win and a spot in the final on July 19 with Spain.

articles.description: Argentina players celebrated their World Cup semi-final victory over England by holding a banner about the Falkland Islands on the pitch in Atlanta.
